about.title: Lawndale Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a traffic collision changes everything, and Lawndale families are not immune to that reality. Los Angeles County recorded traffic deaths on local streets in recent years, including corridors like Hawthorne Boulevard and Inglewood Avenue where crash volume tends to be higher. California law gives a narrow group of people the right to bring a wrongful death claim, typically a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, followed by other dependents or heirs if none exist. These claims are separate from any criminal proceedings tied to the crash and follow their own civil timeline. LawProactive is not a law firm, but we connect grieving families in Lawndale with an independent personal injury attorney who can explain standing, deadlines, and what losses may be recoverable. There's no cost to start a conversation, and the attorneys in our network only get paid if there's a recovery for your family.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Independent Attorney First

items.title: Standing Rules Are Specific
items.desc: California limits who can file a wrongful death claim, usually starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children before other dependents or heirs. An attorney can confirm where your family fits before any paperwork moves forward.

items.title: The Clock Starts at Death
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity was involved. Waiting too long can close the door on a claim entirely.

items.title: Contingency Means No Upfront Cost
items.desc: Attorneys in the LawProactive network work on contingency, so there's no fee unless your family recovers compensation. That structure lets grieving families focus on healing instead of legal bills.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Typically a surviving spouse, registered domestic partner, or children have first standing to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs under California law may be eligible. An independent attorney can review your family's specific situation to confirm eligibility.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash in Lawndale?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. That period is shorter if the crash involved a government-owned road or vehicle, which can matter given corridors like Hawthorne Boulevard or Rosecrans Avenue that see heavier traffic volume. It's best to speak with an attorney as soon as you're able.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to any criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action from any criminal charges the driver may face. The outcome of one does not determine the outcome of the other, and families can pursue a civil claim regardless of criminal proceedings. An attorney can explain how the two processes may still intersect.
